claim.claim-text: 1. A mechanochemical process to produce exfoliated nanoparticles, said method comprising the following steps
2. A mechanochemical process according to claim 1 wherein the carbon dioxide comprises carbon dioxide emissions from burning fossil fuels, or carbon dioxide emissions from cement manufacturing.

3. A mechanochemical process according to claim 1 or 2, wherein said carbonaceous and/or mineral-based material is selected from the group consisting of fly ash, bottom ash, incinerator ash, graphite, petroleum coke, anthracite coke, bituminous coal, activated charcoal, olivine, talc, yellowstone, serpentine, and combinations thereof.

4. A mechanochemical process according to claim 3, wherein said carbonaceous and/or mineral-based material is selected from fly ash, bottom ash, incinerator ash, graphite, petroleum coke, anthracite coke, bituminous coal, activated charcoal, olivine, talc, yellowstone, serpentine.

5. A mechanochemical process according to claim 4, wherein said carbonaceous and/or mineral-based material is selected from the group consisting of fly ash, bottom ash, incinerator ash and combinations thereof.
6. A mechanochemical process according to claim 5, wherein said carbonaceous and/or mineral-based material is fly ash.
7. A mechanochemical process according to claims 2 and 6.
8. A mechanochemical process according to any one of the preceding claims wherein the solid feedstock comprises less than 15% of water, based on total weight of the feedstock.

9. A mechanochemical process according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein said mechanochemical agitation operation comprises mixing, stirring (low-speed stirring or high-speed stirring), shearing (high-torque shearing), shaking, blending or ultrasonication.

10. A mechanochemical process according to anyone of the preceding claims, wherein said process further comprises the addition of a catalyst to said solid feedstock, wherein said catalyst comprises a metal oxide selected from the group consisting of iron oxides, cobalt oxides, rhenium oxides, titanium oxides and combinations thereof.
